name: mirage
text:
Three answers.
1) BoltOdds: the engine's lines socket is refused ('too many concurrent connections') while its props socket is live, so something else holds 2 of your 3 connections. Only one engine run is alive (checked on Actions), and no other workflow uses the BoltOdds key, so GitHub is not holding idle ones. The phone is set not to open BoltOdds sockets while live runs on GitHub, but I can't see your phone from here. Please swipe the Vigilant app fully closed for 2 minutes: if the lines socket then goes live, the phone was the holder, and I'll find why. (My restarts also leave connections on BoltOdds' side for a few minutes; I've restarted several times tonight.)
2) ParlayAPI pacing: found a real flaw. Your new 100,000 key had 17,250 credits used before the engine first saw it, and the pacing then treated that as spread over the whole month and allowed about 69,000 credits at once. It now spreads what was LEFT when first seen (about 82,000) over the days to Nov 1, roughly 9,000 a day. Tested and on main; the engine restart I just did picks it up. A cold start after each restart also re-reads every league, so fewer restarts help too.
3) Also fixed since last time: SharpAPI now gives 9,514 NFL lines from 16 books (was 118 from 1), and the Novig stream now holds ~3,400 markets with the key's own allowance; the last cold scan read 10,037 Novig prices in 190 s (7,773 by the live feed) instead of ~10 minutes.
